name: GrubMarket
long_description: GrubMarket is the AI-powered technology enabler and digital transformer of American Food Supply Chain industry. Our mission is to build and provide the eCommerce and software technologies to this industry, to transform this completely offline and highly manual industry into modernized online industry powered by software technologies, and improve the efficiency of American food supply chain.

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer: I started the company self-funded. So I had to work full-time on another job and can only work at this company at my spare time including weekends until about 10 months later. This company started at my garage.

question_answers.question: How did you decide to apply to Y Combinator? What was your experience applying, going through the batch, and fundraising at demo day?
question_answers.answer: I heard Y Combinator has incubated many great companies and I wanted to be part of them. That is why I applied for it.
